text: This document provides the description of the requirements and stage-2 information models to implement an Acceleration Abstraction Layer \(AAL\) for the MUMIMO Precoder/BeamFormer Calculation functionality hosted by an AAL-LPU that is associated with an O-RAN Network Function.
text_preview: This document provides the description of the requirements and stage-2 information models to implement an Acceleration Abstraction Layer \(AAL\) for the MUMIMO Precoder/BeamFormer Calculation functionality hosted by an AAL-LPU that is associated with an O-RAN Network Function.

text: This document specifies how to accelerate the functionality of an O-RAN network function where the MUMIMO Precoder/BeamFormer Calculation Acceleration Function \(AF\) is hosted on an AAL-LPU that is assigned to the AAL Application that is part of the O-RAN network function. This document also specifies a set of AAL Profiles and procedures for utilizing the AALI Common Management \(AALI-C-Mgmt\) and Application \(AALI-C-App\) interfaces to convey the information elements specified by the AAL Profiles.
text_preview: This document specifies accelerating MUMIMO Precoder/BeamFormer Calculation AF on an O-RAN network function's AAL Application, defining AAL Profiles and procedures for utilizing AALI-C-Mgmt and AALI-C-App interfaces to convey information elements specified by the profiles.

text: The AAL General Aspects and Principles is described in \[7\] including a high-level architecture of the AAL and definition of the AAL profiles. This document details the AAL specification consisting of the description of the interface, information models, and requirements to implement an AALI for AAL\_MUMIMO\_PRECODER\_WEIGHTS\_CAL profile \[7\]
text_preview: The AAL General Aspects and Principles is described in [7], including a high-level architecture of the AAL and definition of profiles. This document details the AAL specification, covering interface description, information models, and requirements for implementing an AALI for the AAL_MUMIMO_PRECODER_WEIGHTS_CAL profile [7].

text: The purpose of the AAL\_MUMIMO\_PRECODER\_WEIGHTS\_CAL profile is to support look-aside acceleration of beamforming \(precoding\) weight calculation by the Application. This profile compliments the High-PHY profiles specified in \[8\].
text_preview: The purpose of the AAL\_MUMIMO\_PRECODER\_WEIGHTS\_CAL profile is to support look-aside acceleration of beamforming \(precoding\) weight calculation by the Application. This profile compliments the High-PHY profiles specified in \[8\].

text: This present document is structured as follows: Chapter 4 presents the overview and main purpose of this specification. Chapter 5 presents the high level AALI configuration and management principles for the AAL\_MU MIMO\_PRECODER\_WEIGHTS\_CAL profile. Chapter 6 presents the Profile Overview for the profile, sample capabilities, inputs, and outputs as well as HWA parameters for the profile.

text: The Application provides HWA \(aka AF in \[8\]\) with all the information required to calculate precoding weights, as shown in Table 6.3.4-1. HWA computes MU-MIMO precoding weights according to an implementation-specific method, one exemplary method being block diagonalization.
trace: Introduction --> 6.3 MUMIMO Precoder/BeamFormer Calculation Profile Specification --> 6.3.2 Profile Operation
text_preview: The Application provides HWA \(aka AF in \[8\]\) with all the information required to calculate precoding weights, as shown in Table 6.3.4-1. HWA computes MU-MIMO precoding weights according to an implementation-specific method, one exemplary method being block diagonalization.

text: HWA returns to the Application a handle\* \(optional\) to the precoding weights for the layers of the selected UEs together with precoding weights themselves. The precoding weights can be used by the Application to compute SINR per UE and per layer to assist with MCS selection.
trace: Introduction --> 6.3 MUMIMO Precoder/BeamFormer Calculation Profile Specification --> 6.3.2 Profile Operation
text_preview: HWA returns to the Application a handle\* \(optional\) to the precoding weights for the layers of the selected UEs together with precoding weights themselves. The precoding weights can be used by the Application to compute SINR per UE and per layer to assist with MCS selection.

text: Application sends the precoding weights \(optional\) or handle \(optional\) to AF \[8\] via AAL\_DOWNLINK\_High-PHY Profile \[8\].
trace: Introduction --> 6.3 MUMIMO Precoder/BeamFormer Calculation Profile Specification --> 6.3.2 Profile Operation
text_preview: Application sends the precoding weights \(optional\) or handle \(optional\) to AF \[8\] via AAL\_DOWNLINK\_High-PHY Profile \[8\].

text: \*Handle represents an index to "Beamforming \(precoding\) weights per PRG for the layers of the selected UEs" uniquely. This is an optional parameter. It is introduced to enable following example implementation option:

text_preview: \*Handle represents an index to "Beamforming \(precoding\) weights per PRG for the layers of the selected UEs" uniquely. This is an optional parameter. It is introduced to enable following example implementation option:

text: After precoding weights calculation, HWA stores the precoding weights locally together with the associated handle. HWA returns to Application the handle to the precoding weights as well as the precoding weights for the layers of the selected UEs. This provides option to Application to send just the handle to AF \[8\] in AAL\_DOWNLINK\_High-PHY Profile \[8\]. In this case, AF can use the handle to retrieve precoding weights stored locally.
trace: Introduction --> 6.3 MUMIMO Precoder/BeamFormer Calculation Profile Specification --> 6.3.2 Profile Operation
text_preview: After precoding weight calculation, HWA stores local precoding weights and their associated handles. It returns these handles to Application along with the precoding weights for selected UEs' layers. This allows Application to send only the handle to AF, which can then retrieve stored precoding weights locally.

text: NOTE: This is applicable only for the sencario in which same HWA is used for "high Phy function" and "precoding weights calculation function".
